module.anchors: the 360 graft slots, copied verbatim from the dropped blocks by the frozen operator

frozen_anchor.note: loaded from the finished anchor-only run and never updated; its digest is compared before and after training

module.candidates: the top-4 leftovers of each anchor's own source block, selected by a bilinear score and mixed at their native 4096 dimensions
module.bound: vector norm, not element-wise: delta = raw * bound / (bound + rms(raw)) with bound = gate * max_ratio * rms(anchor). The direction of the residual is untouched, and no coordinate saturates against the bound on its own
module.initialization: the score and down projections are orthogonal and the output projection is zero: the fused window starts bit-identical to the AnchorOnly window, not to the grafted one

objective.loss: answer cross-entropy of the compacted window
objective.protection_reference: the frozen AnchorOnly window, because the branch starts there and KL against the graft would push it to undo the calibration
